long:
At the Pace of a Regulated Nervous System

My journey in somatic coaching began with a deep curiosity about the body's innate wisdom. As a certified trauma-informed practitioner, I specialize in psychedelic integration and addiction recovery, helping individuals navigate their inner landscapes at a pace that respects the nervous system's capacity for healing.
​
When safety is prioritized, true transformation can occur. This is why we establish trust and connection before any deep work begins and refer out if we see our clients need prior support with a different professional. We make sure the shifts that happen are in line with what your psyche and body can process.
